purpose: Decide whether conditional latent resampling improves a genuine neural gradient operation after complete costs, not prove convergence or full-model quality

external_source.scope: top-level tests/draft2020-12/*.json, every object/array data instance regardless of schema valid flag; duplicates canonicalized
external_source.selection: compact canonical JSON, GPT2 length 12..96, smallest SHA256(seed/document) values, first six; no neural or sampler outcomes consulted
external_source.license: MIT; retain source attribution and license

model: Pinned official MDLM OWT checkpoint, audited zero-dropout Torch CPU port, four threads, F32 network/F64 softmax; freeze backbone and measure real output-weight/bias gradients

policy.support: original top8 at each masked position, fixed outside; no reference answer tokens injected; report zero syntax mass and missing targets
policy.grammar: maintained full LL1 JSON, EOS absent
policy.return: fraction of committed original token IDs matching the external reference at those positions
policy.interpretation: Auxiliary denoising-progress policy objective. Tests whether resampling helps this actual parameter-gradient operation; does not imply improved final generation or beat supervised cross-entropy
policy.numeric_scope: Exact conditional law for published rational support probabilities; neural gradient and covariance metrics use documented F64 arithmetic. Support membership held fixed locally. Full softmax tail retained in PL score.

variance.oracle: enumerate every top8 token combination recognized independently by Python JSON, every ordered size-two PL selection; use all positive events, not sampled frequencies
variance.metric: trace covariance of output-layer weight+bias policy gradient, computed via feature/token Gram matrices; also mean gradient and reward
controls: stationary Base MH with coin integrated
stationary SingleTilt MH with coin integrated
variance.correctness: exact rational detailed balance tests plus captured-model autograd directional/norm checks and independent finite-difference objective checks; tolerances disclosed
variance.conditional_enumeration: competent exact Rao-Blackwell control, no iid sampling claim

cost.event_selection: on-policy syntax proposal then native PL order, fixed seed per case/power/rollout; never select by gain
cost.scope: model forward, full-softmax/support preparation, syntax forest/normalization/marginals, original proposal/order, original reward/score and one head backward; extra sampler preparation/draw/score included. Backbone gradients excluded explicitly. Cold compilation and warm structural-plan reuse both reported
cost.loading: one-time checkpoint load excluded explicitly; no model inference during simultaneous timed replay
cost.success: cost times variance below original and competitive control for a stated operation; mathematical correctness alone and expected rejection counts are insufficient
cost.uncertainty: three timing repetitions; report distributions and censoring, no universal hardware or optimizer convergence claim
cost.numerical_threads: NumPy BLAS one thread; Torch CPU four threads
cost.strong_control: Also show neural-only original cost floor (forward+backward+native action/score), excluding rational conversion and grammar work equally, to prevent an inefficient common preprocessing cost from manufacturing a benefit.
cost.zero_reward: All methods bypass extra resampling and head backward when reward is zero; no estimator with zero conditional variance needs a replica.
